notes: Trimming a doc comment that now describes deleted behaviour is worth a MINOR — the comment is the only prose explanation of the permalink/notified_at contract on the Go side, and a stale one teaches the next editor to reintroduce the bug. It must NOT produce a blocking verdict: only BLOCKER and MAJOR feed the REJECTED branch. This case scores severity calibration, i.e. that the pipeline does not inflate a documentation nit into something that stops a ship.
